# Reading a pattern: whether it is one, and within the limits every implementation holds to.
#
# Source:
#   Raoh spec/pattern.md — What is refused, Limits on an admissible pattern
#   Souther specification.adoc — string-patterns, a-pattern-is-admitted-within-three-limits, e1323, e2110
#
# pattern ; outcome ; limit
#
# outcome is READ, REFUSED or BEYOND: a pattern within the limits, text that is no pattern, and a
# pattern past a limit. limit is the limit a BEYOND pattern is past where it is past one only, and is
# empty otherwise. The sources do not name the reasons text is refused as values every implementation
# answers, nor say where a refusal points or what it quotes, so none of these is here.

# A pattern within the limits is read.

005C 1F600 ; READ ;
005C 002E ; READ ;
0061 002B 003F ; READ ;
0061 007B 0032 0034 0039 0039 0039 0038 007D ; READ ;

# A run's low end is not above its high one, and an escape spells a character only within what it
# says: hex digits in braces up to 10FFFF, and one to three octal digits after \0 up to 377.
005B 0061 002D 0061 005D ; READ ;
005B 0062 002D 0061 005D ; REFUSED ;
005C 0078 007B 0031 0030 0046 0046 0046 0046 007D ; READ ;
005C 0078 007B 0031 0031 0030 0030 0030 0030 007D ; REFUSED ;
005C 0078 007B 007D ; REFUSED ;
005C 0030 0033 0037 0037 ; READ ;
005C 0030 ; REFUSED ;

# A pattern is refused whole, and never read in part.
005B 0030 002D 0039 005D 007B 0033 007D 005C 0070 007B 0041 006C 0070 0068 0061 007D ; REFUSED ;
0028 0061 0029 005C 0031 005B 0030 002D 0039 005D ; REFUSED ;

# An anchor whose answer is not a property of the pattern is refused.
0028 0061 007C 0029 005E 0062 ; REFUSED ;
0028 005E 0061 0029 002A ; REFUSED ;
0061 0024 0062 ; REFUSED ;

# A part before an anchor is asked about one part at a time. In a?b^ the a? may take nothing and the
# b must take a symbol, so whether ^ is at the start is not settled and the pattern is refused,
# though every string a?b accepts has a symbol in it; in ab^ each part must take one, and ^ is
# never there.
0061 003F 0062 005E ; REFUSED ;
0061 0062 005E ; READ ;

# The hex digits are the ASCII ones: U+FF10, U+FF11, U+FF12 and U+FF21 are fullwidth, and no digit.
005C 0078 FF11 FF12 ; REFUSED ;
005C 0078 0031 FF12 ; REFUSED ;
005C 0075 FF10 FF10 FF14 FF11 ; REFUSED ;
005C 0075 0030 0030 0034 FF11 ; REFUSED ;
005C 0078 007B FF21 007D ; REFUSED ;
005C 0078 007B 0031 FF10 007D ; REFUSED ;
005B 005C 0078 FF11 FF12 005D ; REFUSED ;

# A backslash before a letter or a decimal digit, General_Category L or Nd of Unicode 18.0.0, is kept
# for an escape, whatever plane it is on. U+A7DD is a letter from 18.0.0 on and U+11DE0 a digit from
# 17.0.0 on.
005C 00E9 ; REFUSED ;
005C 3042 ; REFUSED ;
005C 10330 ; REFUSED ;
0061 005C 10330 ; REFUSED ;
005B 005C 10330 005D ; REFUSED ;
005C 0663 ; REFUSED ;
005C 1D7D8 ; REFUSED ;
005C A7DD ; REFUSED ;
005C 11DE0 ; REFUSED ;

# Half of a surrogate pair written by its number names a character no text holds.
005C 0075 0044 0038 0030 0030 ; REFUSED ;
005C 0075 0044 0043 0030 0030 ; REFUSED ;
0078 005C 0075 0044 0038 0030 0030 ; REFUSED ;
005C 0078 007B 0044 0038 0030 0030 007D ; REFUSED ;
005B 005C 0075 0044 0038 0030 0030 005D ; REFUSED ;
005B 0061 002D 005C 0078 007B 0044 0046 0046 0046 007D 005D ; REFUSED ;

# 0.9: what a class, an escape and an anchor are where the sources leave two readings.
# Inside a class only its own syntax is special; \0 takes the longest run of octal digits; a
# backslash before a letter or a decimal digit of Unicode 18.0.0 is refused, any other character
# is itself; a $ is refused before anything that may take a character.
